title: The Hive must Grow!
description: This Mod adds a few blocks that synergize with the honeycomb and honey blocks, This mod is based for building, right now there are only 4 new blocks, but more will follow.
body:
The Hive must grow is a Small Mod made for an extension of the Honeycomb and Honey Block, As there are is just not enough content to Bees In my opinion. Right now there are 4 New Blocks,

- Honeycomb Plank
- Honeycomb Slab
- Honeycomb Stair
- Honey Lantern
- Honeycomb Pillar
- Glossy Honeycomb

I mainly just recolored blocks...
These Blocks all have Custom Recipes (Which are subject to change)
**THIS MOD IS MADE WITH MCREATOR**
